title: A Postcard from the Beach
description: Practise be, can and like + -ing, and write a holiday postcard.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "is" with one thing (it): the water is warm.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with can or can't.
exercises.text: The sea is calm, so we ___ swim.
exercises.explanation: Use "can" + base verb to say something is possible: we can swim.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We play on the beach every day.
Every day we play on the beach.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + place + time: We play on the beach every day.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: With a plural subject (they), the verb has no -s: my parents like.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: After like, love and hate, use the -ing form: likes building.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There is many shops near the beach.
answers: There are many shops near the beach.
exercises.explanation: Use "there are" with plural nouns: there are many shops.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: We swim ___ the sea every morning.
exercises.explanation: We swim "in" the sea because we are inside the water.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with have or has.
exercises.text: Our room ___ got a big window.
exercises.explanation: Use "has got" with it (our room = it): our room has got.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There are two beachs near our hotel.
answers: There are two beaches near our hotel.
exercises.explanation: Nouns ending in -ch take -es in the plural: beaches.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Noun + is + very + adjective: The sand is very hot.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I can see ___ island from my window.
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an island.

exercises.prompt: Write in, on or at.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days of the week: on Sunday.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: It is very hot, ___ we swim every day.
exercises.explanation: Use "so" to give a result: it is hot, so we swim.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My sister loves she new sunglasses.
answers: My sister loves her new sunglasses.
exercises.explanation: Use "her" (not "she") before a noun to show that something belongs to a girl or woman.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + can + verb: We can see the boats.

exercises.prompt: Complete with the negative form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: My brother ___ (not / like) the cold water.
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, make the negative with doesn't (does not) + verb: he doesn't like.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: ___ there a swimming pool at your hotel?
exercises.explanation: Make questions with "Is there" + a singular noun: Is there a swimming pool?

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days of the week, not "in": on Saturday.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: There is a cafe near the beach.
Near the beach there is a cafe.
Is there a cafe near the beach?
exercises.explanation: There is + a singular noun + place: There is a cafe near the beach.

exercises.prompt: Write the possessive adjective for the word in brackets.
exercises.text: We love ___ (we) hotel. It is very nice.
exercises.explanation: The possessive adjective for "we" is "our": our hotel.

task.prompt: You are on holiday at the beach. Write a postcard to a friend.
contentPoints: Say where you are and who you are with.
Describe the weather and the beach.
Say what you do every day.
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Sam,

I'm in Nice with my family. The weather is hot and sunny, and the beach is beautiful. Every day we swim in the sea and eat ice cream. I can see boats from our hotel!

We come home on Sunday. See you soon!

Mia
